description.zh: 回滚的异步操作超时时间。单位：秒。默认值：300。
description.en: The timeout period of the asynchronous rollback operation. Unit: seconds. Default value: 300.

description.zh: 目标版本号。默认自动回滚到上一版本。
description.en: The target version number. By default, the system automatically rolls back the container version to the previous version.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens rollback-application --app-id 474bdef0-d149-4695-abfb-52912d910000 --from-app-version v2-1 --to-app-version v2 --timeout 1800 --region cn-hangzhou
